abort.missing_credentials: Add Ford Connect application credentials before configuring the integration.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: Ford Connect application credentials are temporarily unavailable.
abort.oauth_failed: Ford Connect could not complete OAuth authentication.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Ford Connect rejected the authorization request.
abort.oauth_error: Ford Connect returned an invalid OAuth response.
abort.external_url_required: Ford Connect requires a configured, externally reachable HTTPS URL. Set Home Assistant's External URL and try again.
abort.invalid_callback: The callback URL must be the complete Ford redirect to http://localhost:8080/callback.
abort.invalid_state: The authorization link has expired, was already used, or does not belong to this setup attempt.

user.title: Authentication method
user.description: Automatic uses Home Assistant's externally reachable HTTPS URL. Manual works on a LAN-only Home Assistant.

manual_auth.title: Complete manual Ford authentication
manual_auth.description: Open [Ford authorization]({authorization_url}), then copy the complete localhost callback URL from your browser address bar. A connection error is expected.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Ford Connect
reauth_confirm.description: Ford Connect needs to authenticate again.

application_credentials.description: Create an application at [Ford Developer]({developer_url}). Register the redirect URI documented in this integration's README, then enter the Client ID and Client Secret here.
